name: less
description: Page through text one screen at a time

--chop-long-lines
options.description: Cut long lines instead of wrapping

name: -i
--ignore-case
options.description: Ignore case in searches unless they have capitals

name: -F
--quit-if-one-screen
options.description: Exit right away if it fits on one screen

name: -X
--no-init
options.description: Leave the text on screen after exiting

--LONG-PROMPT
